UNDER THE MICROSCOPE

A connectome isn't
a runnable brain.

FlyWire Codex lists MCNS v1.0: the male adult fly brain and nerve cord, with 166,700 neurons and 6,242,118 connections. Its data tools require Google sign-in.

This gym starts with a small synthetic recurrent network. Hunger, fatigue and novelty influence activity, and an artificial readout chooses exercises. Training and muscle growth are fictional.

Bring your own MCNS subnetwork

Import a JSON graph (up to 5,000 neurons / 50,000 edges). Real connections will drive the recurrent model; stimulus mappings, dynamics and gym readouts remain artificial. No full-brain or biological fidelity is claimed.

{"source":"MCNS v1.0","neurons":["123","456"],
 "edges":[{"pre":"123","post":"456","weight":4}]}

Use string neuron IDs. Positive weights are excitatory; negative weights are inhibitory only if independently supported. Synapse counts alone don't establish sign. Imports replace the controller for this session.
